units.source_text: “……不过，阿留姐不管有没有受伊作的骗，结果还不是一样吗？

en.t: "...But whether Sister Aru was deceived by Isaku or not, did it not end the same way?

units.source_text: 可恨的又不是伊作一个人……”

en.t: Isaku is not the only one who deserves blame..."
Ah Guang watched Aru go off into the distance.

units.source_text: 她双脚做好踏镫的准备，将上半身微向前躬，再稍稍后退保持平衡，然后用脚后跟策马飞快地跑了……

en.t: She set both feet as if ready to press into the stirrups, bent her upper body slightly forward, then drew back a little to keep her balance, and drove the horse on with her heels, racing away...

units.source_text: 你看，到现在阿留走路的姿势不是也没摆脱当年的模样吗？

en.t: Look, even now, has Aru's way of walking really escaped the shape it had back then?

units.source_text: 她伸开短腿，摇摇晃晃地迈步，那样子不就是当年骑在马背上的姿势吗？

en.t: She spreads her short legs and staggers forward, and is that not exactly the posture she had when she was riding on horseback?

units.source_text: 她屁股往后坠，如果没有那件短夹外衣遮掩，她的背影也实在不堪入目啊。

en.t: Her hips sag backward, and if that short jacket were not hiding them, the sight of her from behind would truly be hard to look at.
